gate.cheer1: Confirm your Aadhaar-linked mobile to unlock the listing form.
gate.cheer2: Enter the 6-digit OTP to finish verifying.
gate.verifySub: You'll verify once with an Aadhaar OTP before you can post — it keeps every PuneNest listing genuine. Your number is never shown publicly.
gate.mismatchTitle: Sign in with your Aadhaar-linked number
gate.mismatchBodyPre: Your Aadhaar is linked to exactly one mobile number, and that has to be the number you sign in with — it's how we keep every listing genuine and duplicate-free. You're signed in as
gate.mismatchBodyPost: Sign in again with your Aadhaar-linked mobile to verify and post.

success.editApprovedBody: Your updates are saved and your listing stays live. Our team is re-checking the core details you changed and will confirm shortly.
success.editBody: Your changes are saved and live. Everything you updated is now visible to buyers and tenants.
success.newBody: Our team will verify and publish your listing within 24 hours. You'll receive a notification once it's live.

modal.startOverBody: This clears every detail you've entered — including photos and documents — and returns you to a blank form. This can't be undone.
modal.identityTitle: This looks like a different property
modal.identityBodyPost: , which makes this a different property rather than an update to your existing one. Keep your current listing as it is and post this one separately. Your free listing stays yours — additional listings need an Owner plan.
modal.dupBodyPost: — we matched it by its address and electricity meter. Publishing it again would create a duplicate, which hurts your reach and buyer trust. Edit or renew your existing listing instead of posting a new one.
